pattern.description: The Marketing Email analytics screen zooms and dissolves into the Deals kanban board, which arrives oversized and pulls back to full view. A grab-hand cursor is already dragging a deal card from Contract Sent toward Closed Won.
pattern.why_premium: Using a scale dissolve between two real product screens keeps the sense of one continuous app instead of a hard cut, and arriving on a live drag puts the viewer straight into the action that shows the CRM pipeline.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.screen-email', {scale:1.15, opacity:0, duration:0.3, ease:'power2.in'}); tl.fromTo('.screen-deals', {scale:1.6, opacity:0}, {scale:1, opacity:1, duration:0.35, ease:'power3.out'}, '<0.05'); then tl.to(['.drag-card','.cursor'], {x:'+=60', duration:0.3, ease:'power1.inOut'}) for the drag.
build_hint.remotion: Outgoing: opacity interpolate(frame,[0,7],[1,0]), scale interpolate(frame,[0,7],[1,1.15],{easing:Easing.in(Easing.quad)}). Incoming: scale interpolate(frame,[1,9],[1.6,1],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}), opacity interpolate(frame,[1,6],[0,1]). Drag: translateX interpolate(frame,[9,17],[0,60],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}).

notes: The outgoing Marketing Email dashboard is not in the end frame, so it has no box; it zooms in and fades out. camera.move is pull_out (scale 0.62), which matches the incoming board settling. The drag of the deal card may continue past this event (the energy rises again in the last frame).
